name: Acid
notes: Venomole's move 2 (B). Spills acid on the 3x3 tiles in front of the user for 3 s; every monster the acid touches is hurt at once, then every half second while it stays (each monster has its own timer). Wild monsters only use it when the player is within 3 tiles; the player's goes off anyway. Charge: 10 s.
title: ACID
